title: The WAVES open to Black women
photo_credit: Harriet Ida Pickens and Frances Wills after graduating from the Naval Reserve Midshipmen's School, Northampton, Massachusetts, December 1944. U.S. Navy photo 80-G-297441 (NARA), public domain. Taken about two months after the 19 October announcement.

title: A 1944 drone strike

title: Aachen surrenders
photo_credit: German prisoners taken at the fall of Aachen marching through the ruined streets, October 1944. NARA 541597, public domain.

title: Churchill speaks to France
photo_credit: Winston Churchill at his desk, early in his time as prime minister. British official photograph, Crown copyright expired, public domain; exact catalogue number not confirmed. Supplied by Brian 16 Oct 2026. Shown dimmed behind the quote.

title: Mark Clark's secret landing
photo_credit: HMS Seraph, the submarine that carried Clark to Cherchell, entering harbor with crew on deck. Imperial War Museum wartime official photograph (British official WWII photos are out of Crown Copyright), copy from USNI Naval History, April 2023, supplied by Brian 16 Oct 2026. Likely Seraph's return to Portsmouth, Dec 1943 (IWM A 21106 series); exact catalogue number not confirmed. Replaces a Nov 1942 portrait of Clark (Truman Library 99-216) and before that a postwar portrait.

title: This Is the Army takes its last bow
photo_credit: Irving Berlin, in his First World War uniform, backstage with soldiers at This Is the Army. U.S. Army Signal Corps photo 111-SC-279543, public domain. Taken during the show's run, not at the final performance.

title: The barrage at El Alamein
photo_credit: A 25 pounder gun firing during the night barrage that opened the Second Battle of El Alamein, 23 October 1942. No. 1 Army Film and Photographic Unit, IWM E 18469, public domain (Crown copyright expired).

title: The Sherman's first battle
photo_credit: Sherman II tanks of the Queen's Bays moving up to the Alamein line, 24 October 1942. IWM E 18380, Crown copyright expired, public domain.

title: UN Charter takes effect
